privacyBody: This page sends the details you enter to the clinic you chose so staff can contact you about an appointment. Requests are stored by Apexo's booking service for at most 90 days (30 days after the clinic handles them) and are visible only to the clinic's staff. Do not include medical details. The clinic, not Apexo, provides the care; a request is not a confirmed appointment.
name: Name
phoneHint: Include the country code, for example +966551234567
consent: I agree to the privacy notice
notConfirmed: This is not a confirmed appointment — the clinic will contact you.
notAcceptingRequests: This clinic is not currently accepting appointment requests.
notFoundBody: This address does not belong to a clinic.
errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errorRateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait and try again.
errorQueueFull: The clinic's request queue is full. Please try again later.
errorClinicDisabled: This clinic is not currently accepting requests.
errorInvalidFields: Please check the fields marked below.
errorUnavailable: Requests are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errorIdempotency: This request conflicts with an earlier submission.
fieldPhone: Enter an international number beginning with +.
notePrivacy: Please do not include medical details.
noscript: JavaScript is required to send an appointment request. Please enable JavaScript or call the clinic directly.
